grain: one frozen Formal Entry; 505 rows, 242 normal-close and 263 board-intent
decision_as_of: Entry T close, Asia/Shanghai; same-close fill remains a counterfactual
source: REAL_RESEARCH_SNAPSHOT_V1 AmazingData D3 daily_bars, D4/D6 daily_status, trading_calendar; frozen entries.csv. Scope is Shanghai/Shenzhen A shares only; Beijing exchange is absent, so market turnover is an SH/SZ A proxy rather than literal all-China A.
source_semantics: D3 amount/close and D4/D6 preclose/limit bounds are T end-of-day observations. D4 preclose incorporates daily ex-right reference where applicable. No intraday availability or post-close execution is claimed.
forbidden: H1+ market rows for an Entry
read_boundary: The chronological D3/D4 scan is explicitly capped at the latest frozen Entry T (2026-09-22); each earlier Entry receives only its <=T rolling prefix through an as-of guard.
snapshot_integrity_note: Snapshot open hashes all constituents including D8; feature SQL loads only D3/D4 economic rows and calendar.

turnover_20d_percentile.available_by_entry_T: after T close only; no same-close execution claim
turnover_20d_percentile.missing_policy: null if fewer than 20 sessions or amount unavailable

market_breadth_score.timestamp_semantics: T finalized close/preclose and T vendor price bounds
market_breadth_score.available_by_entry_T: after T close only; no same-close execution claim
market_breadth_score.missing_policy: null if valid status coverage <98%; no zero fill

prior_limit_up_next_day_median_return.source_dataset: snapshot D3 daily_bars + D4/D6 daily_status + calendar
prior_limit_up_next_day_median_return.timestamp_semantics: T-1 close-limit-up identity and T full-session return
prior_limit_up_next_day_median_return.missing_policy: null if either day coverage <98% or T returns fewer than 5

high_position_negative_feedback_rate.source_dataset: snapshot D3 daily_bars + D4/D6 daily_status + calendar
high_position_negative_feedback_rate.timestamp_semantics: T-1 >=3 consecutive close-limit-up securities, T returns
high_position_negative_feedback_rate.calculation_window: consecutive history through T-1; T cross-section
high_position_negative_feedback_rate.missing_policy: null if >=3-board denominator <5 or current/prior streak source quality insufficient

high_board_advancement_rate.source_dataset: snapshot D3 daily_bars + D4/D6 daily_status + calendar
high_board_advancement_rate.timestamp_semantics: T-1 >=2 consecutive close-limit-up securities advancing at T
high_board_advancement_rate.calculation_window: consecutive history through T-1; T cross-section
high_board_advancement_rate.missing_policy: null if >=2-board denominator <5 or current/prior streak source quality insufficient

shortline_style_score.timestamp_semantics: T daily components standardized only against <=T daily history
shortline_style_score.calculation_window: component history 60 sessions through T, min 20
shortline_style_score.missing_policy: require >=3/5 nonmissing component percentiles; otherwise null

trend_style_score.source_dataset: T Top100 D3 amount basket + D4 preclose-derived synthetic index
trend_style_score.timestamp_semantics: T amount ranking and T/earlier compounded returns
trend_style_score.calculation_window: stock MA20 and 5-session return; component percentile 60 sessions through T, min 20
trend_style_score.missing_policy: require >=80/100 stock values per component and all 3 component percentiles

market_liquidity: SH/SZ A sum(D3 amount), CNY, excluding Beijing. MA20: trailing 20 sessions including T. Percentile20/60: empirical fraction of trailing 20/60 turnover observations <= T, min 20/60. Three-day slope: turnover(T)/turnover(T-3)-1. No fixed trillion-CNY threshold.
breadth: Universe: D3 traded A shares with matching valid D4 preclose. Daily return=raw close/D4 preclose-1. Limit-up/down: positive vendor high_limited/low_limited and close within 0.005 CNY of bound. Strong-up/down: return >=+5% / <=-5%. Score=(limit_up+strong_up-limit_down-strong_down)/valid-status count; categories intentionally overlap.
prior_strength: Previous trading-session D4-qualified closing-limit-up securities with T valid D4 return. Median, mean, positive and <=-5% fractions; no prior-stock fill inference. Minimum denominator 5 for primary median.
high_position: Previous trading-session securities with >=3 consecutive qualified closing-limit-up sessions; T <=-5% rate and median return. Minimum denominator 5; otherwise missing, not zero. Advancement is prior >=2-board securities closing limit-up at T, denominator >=5.
continuity: Consecutive boards require adjacent exchange sessions and valid positive D4 high_limited. Missing status breaks a security streak; market-wide high-board context is missing on a deficient day and next three sessions.
source_quality: D4 valid-status coverage / D3 traded rows must be >=0.98 for a daily market/style observation. Prior-universe feedback also requires prior-session >=0.98. Missing rates and small denominators are explicit.
trend_basket: Top 100 D3 amount at T, tie-break security_id. Synthetic price index compounds D3 close/D4 preclose daily return over adjacent sessions only; avoids raw corporate-action discontinuities. Components: basket median T return, fraction index above trailing 20-session index MA, median five-session compounded index return. At least 80/100 valid stock values per component.
style_scores: Each component converted to trailing 60-session empirical percentile including T, min 20 nonmissing observations, then centered at 0.5; no learned weights. Shortline equal-weight available components: high-board count, maximum board height, high-board advancement rate, prior-limit-up median T return, inverse high-position <=-5% rate. Require >=3/5. Trend equal-weight: Top100 median T return, above-MA20 fraction, median five-session return; require 3/3. Missing components never zero-imputed.
style_regime: style_differential=shortline_style_score-trend_style_score. >+0.10 SHORTLINE_DOMINANT; <-0.10 TREND_DOMINANT; otherwise MIXED; fixed before outcome join.
market_risk_regime: Four fixed votes: turnover20 percentile >=2/3 +1 <=1/3 -1; breadth >0 +1 <0 -1; prior-limit-up median >0 +1 <0 -1; high-position <=-5% rate <=0.10 +1 >=0.30 -1. Require >=3 available votes. Sum >=2 RISK_ON, <=-2 RISK_OFF, else NEUTRAL.
diagnostic_bins: For each numeric primary feature, tercile cutpoints computed from 174 frozen 2024-2025 normal-close Entry T context values only, before loading outcomes, then fixed for 2026 and board. Ties are assigned by <= lower, <= upper, > upper; duplicate cutpoints or empty bins are reported, not tuned.
theme: No substitution if PIT dated membership, strength and ranking fail qualification; output THEME_CONTEXT_DEFERRED_DATA_UNQUALIFIED.
hypothesis_admission: Post-outcome exploratory only; H1a prior-limit-up median HIGH vs LOW, H1b high-position negative-feedback LOW vs HIGH, H2 SHORTLINE_DOMINANT vs TREND_DOMINANT. Require >=10 per side per 2024/2025/2026 year and >=20 per side full sample, full TP5/H5 net-mean contrast >=+0.02, H5 <=-10% tail contrast <=-0.05, same favorable net-mean and tail direction in every year, monotonic three-bin net means for H1 features, and leave-one-security-out TP5 contrast >0 for every security. At most three; never approve a filter.
multiple_testing: Eight primary numeric features, two regimes and one market x style interaction; correlated tests, descriptive bootstrap only; no TP/SL selection.
